en: Sepia-toned historical photograph of a two‑storey neoclassical building with a metal roof, arched doorway and tall rectangular windows. Above the entrance and on a corner bay, the word "INCŪKALNS" (printed without diacritics as INCUKALNS) is visible, suggesting it is a railway or public station. A few people stand or sit on the unpaved street and tracks in front of the building. The overall style and wear of the image indicate an early 20th‑century postcard.
